_readme:
Every Form D filed by an Insight-named issuer, with its related persons and
offering facts, read from the local bulk zips (offline). The people named on
the firm's own fund filings (the managing directors of each general partner),
dated per filing, are the roster's filing-grade backbone and the only dated
record of partners who have left (COLLECTION.md 5, the Thrive and Battery
shape). The Insight Equity family (Southlake, Texas) is an unrelated firm and
is kept out by name.
